lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: It's 2:17 in the morning, the air up here is thin and so is the official story. This is Altitude Sickness, I'm Dale Brandvold, and I want you to do something for me. Go to your window. Look east. Look at the airport.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: Now tell me why it's closer than it was last week.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: [mouth full] It's not closer, Dale.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: Terry measured it. Terry measured it with his car.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: I measured my commute.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: Which got shorter, Terry. Ground doesn't shrink. Unless somebody is folding it.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: We'll get to the folding. We'll get to the horse. We'll get to why every pigeon on Colfax is now facing the same direction. But first —

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: [instant, too warm] — but first, a word from Summit Compliance Group.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: I didn't say that. Terry, did I say that?

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: Do you ever lie awake wondering who's watching? At Summit Compliance Group, we have great news. Everyone is. And they love what you're doing.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: Summit Compliance Group helps Denver residents get ahead of their obligations. Whether you owe money, time, or a debt you can't quite remember signing for, our friendly Recovery Partners will meet you wherever you are. We already know where you are.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: Summit Compliance Group. Your cooperation is being recorded for quality and entertainment purposes.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: [very fast] Summit Compliance Group is a subsidiary of Mile High Recovery Solutions. Compliance is not optional. Participation may result in relocation to a lower level. Offer void where the ground is still yours.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: We're back, and I have been informed I did not read that ad, which is exactly what someone who read that ad would be told. Let's talk about the horse.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: Here we go.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: Thirty-two feet of blue fiberglass. Glowing red eyes. Killed its own sculptor. And the official explanation is "public art." Public art, Terry. You know what else is public art? A beacon.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: Last Tuesday, 3:40 AM, the eyes went from red to green. For nine seconds. I have a caller who saw it. Terry, put her through.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: Line two, Dale. It's Marjorie from Aurora.

lines.speaker: Marjorie
lines.text: [elderly, very calm] Hi Dale, long-time listener. I saw the green eyes.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: Thank you, Marjorie. Thank you. Tell them what happened next.

lines.speaker: Marjorie
lines.text: The horse turned its head and looked at my Buick.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: It turned its head.

lines.speaker: Marjorie
lines.text: And then a man in a polo shirt came out of nowhere and put a little sticker on my windshield. It said "Asset Tagged." And a smiley face.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: And what did you do, Marjorie?

lines.speaker: Marjorie
lines.text: I went home, Dale. And when I got there, my house had a little "Asset Tagged" sticker on it too.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: [slow] They're inventorying us.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: Or the HOA got new stickers.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: The HOA has never once smiled, Terry.

lines.speaker: Marjorie
lines.text: Also my grandson got a job offer. It says "Crawler, entry level, no experience necessary, benefits include continued existence."

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: Tell him not to sign it, Marjorie.

lines.speaker: Marjorie
lines.text: He already signed it, Dale. It signed itself. It was very convenient.

lines.speaker: Brad
lines.text: [maximum volume] ARE YOU TIRED OF BEING ALIVE AT A NORMAL SPEED?

lines.speaker: Brad
lines.text: LIQUIDATOR ENERGY. FORTY-ONE TIMES THE CAFFEINE OF A REGULAR SCREAM. FLAVORS INCLUDE: BLUE. ANGRY BLUE. AND FINAL NOTICE, NOW WITH REAL BERRY FLAVOR!

lines.speaker: Brad
lines.text: I DRANK FOUR LIQUIDATORS AND OUTRAN A REPOSSESSION. [beat] I'M STILL RUNNING. I CAN'T STOP. THIS IS A RECORDING. I'M IN NEBRASKA.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: [calm, normal speed] LIQUIDATOR. Liquidate your fatigue. Liquidate your sleep. Liquidate your assets for convenient in-can credit. Do not consume more than one LIQUIDATOR per heartbeat.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: Phones are on fire tonight. Terry, who's next?

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: Line four. Says his name is "Not Gary."

lines.speaker: NotGary
lines.text: [whispering, wind noise] Dale. Dale, I work night maintenance at the airport.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: Go ahead, friend. You're safe here.

lines.speaker: NotGary
lines.text: I'm not, actually, but I appreciate it. Dale, there's a level under the baggage claim. And a level under that one. I went down eleven floors before I found a vending machine.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: What was in the vending machine?

lines.speaker: NotGary
lines.text: Health potions, Dale. Dollar-fifty. And a sign that said "Floor 1, Tutorial, Have Fun!" with the "Fun" in quotation marks.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: [to the audience] The quotation marks, people.

lines.speaker: NotGary
lines.text: And Dale, there was a camera on the ceiling. And it waved at me.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: Cameras don't have hands.

lines.speaker: NotGary
lines.text: This one does now. I have to go. Something's offering me a sponsorship.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: Line one. It's, uh — it says "Vantage Wellness."

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: That's a sponsor, Terry, don't —

lines.speaker: VantageCaller
lines.text: Hi Dale! Big fan.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: Get off my phone line.

lines.speaker: VantageCaller
lines.text: We noticed you're stressed, Dale. Your heart rate spiked forty beats when Not Gary said "eleven floors." Have you considered not knowing things?

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: How do you know my heart rate?

lines.speaker: VantageCaller
lines.text: Vantage Wellness offers a full line of soothing products to help you stop noticing. Try our new Unbothered Tea, steeped in the warm feeling that someone else is handling it.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: [shaking] Terry, kill the line.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: I can't. The button's sponsored.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: Vantage Wellness. Peace of mind is a subscription.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: At Bright Path Solutions, we believe every Denver family deserves a fresh start.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: That's why we're offering every resident a free, no-obligation Life Restructuring. Our experts will review your home, your car, your savings and your skeleton, and find the hidden value inside.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: Many families are surprised to learn they qualify for Down-sizing. One level down. Then another. Families who go all the way down report the most exciting results of all.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: Bright Path Solutions. The light at the end of the tunnel is our logo.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: [fast] Results not typical. Most families are not surprised, they are screaming. Bright Path does not guarantee a path, or that it will be bright, or that it goes anywhere but down.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: All right. Board's up. Terry, read me the strings.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: [flat] Red string: the horse. Red string: the airport getting closer. Red string: the stickers. Blue string: your ex-wife.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: The blue string is a separate investigation.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: Here's what I know, people. Somebody bought this city. Not the land, the show rights. The ground is being folded, like Terry's commute, so it'll fit on a set. Every pigeon on Colfax faces the same way because pigeons face the camera. And every time I get close —

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: — every time you get close to a great deal —

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: NO. Not this time. Every time I get close, a sponsor —

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: — a sponsor like Mile High Recovery Solutions —

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: — who?

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: [quietly, after three seconds of silence] Dale. That's on the paycheck.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: What's on the paycheck?

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: Mile High Recovery Solutions. They own the station. They've owned the station since March.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: [long pause] Since March?

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: They bought the station, the tower, the parking lot, and the concept of AM radio.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: Then why would they let me say any of this?

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: [eating again] 'Cause you rate, Dale. People love you. Your numbers are through the roof. Off-planet, mostly.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: [barely a whisper] I have an audience.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: You have a huge audience.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: Folks. Listeners. [beat] Viewers.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: I've spent twenty years telling you they were watching. Tonight I found out they're watching me. And they're enjoying it. And I don't — Terry, I don't know how to feel about that.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: You could feel good about it. They sent a gift basket.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: There's a gift basket?

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: Came in around midnight. There's LIQUIDATOR in it. And a sticker.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: What does the sticker say, Terry.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: "Asset Tagged." Smiley face.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: [resigned, then rallying] Then here's my message to the folks in the polo shirts. To the people who folded my city. To whoever is up there with the popcorn. I see you. I know you. And I will not be —

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: [gentle] Dale, your segment's over.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: I'm not done.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: Your contract says you're done.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: Terry. Terry, cut the feed.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: Button's sponsored, Dale.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: [final, into the mic] Stay paranoid, Denver. Check under your floors. And if somebody offers you a sponsorship —

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: — say yes! Altitude Sickness was brought to you by Summit Compliance Group, Vantage Wellness, Bright Path Solutions, and LIQUIDATOR. KMHR 5280 AM is a Mile High Recovery Solutions property. Dale Brandvold is a Mile High Recovery Solutions property. You are listening on a Mile High Recovery Solutions property.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: Goodnight, Denver. Don't change the dial. [beat] You can't.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: You're listening to KMHR 5280 AM. Five thousand two hundred and eighty feet above sea level, and sinking.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: This is Dale Brandvold. If you're hearing this, they haven't gotten to the transmitter yet. [beat] Wait.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: KMHR. It's on.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: Traffic update: I-25 is now three feet shorter than it was this morning. Please merge accordingly.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: Weather: clear skies, light ash, a seventy percent chance of a floor opening up beneath you. Back to Dale.

lines.speaker: Brad
lines.text: [distant, out of breath] STILL RUNNING. ENTERING KANSAS. LIQUIDATOR.

lines.speaker: Dale
lines.text: Remember, folks: the horse sees everything. The horse is not your friend. [beat] The horse might be a friend.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: This silence was sponsored. [two seconds of silence] Thank you.
